mapper.sql: p.procurement_id AS procurementId, p.selected_vendor_id AS vendorId, v.vendor_name AS vendorName, i.item_code AS itemCode, i.item_name AS itemName, i.spec AS spec, i.unit AS unit, p.order_qty AS orderQty, p.received_qty AS receivedQty, p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.required_date AS requiredDate, p.status AS status, p.terms AS terms, p.ordered_at AS orderedAt, p.shipped_at AS shippedAt, p.received_at AS receivedAt, p.inspection_result AS inspectionResult
mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_quote q WHERE q.status = 'REQUESTED' AND q.vendor_id = #{vendorId}) AS requestedQuoteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vendor_quote q WHERE q.status = 'SUBMITTED' AND q.vendor_id = #{vendorId}) AS submittedQuoteCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'ORDERED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS orderedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgressCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shippedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status IN ('RETURNED', 'RETURN_REQUESTED', 'RESUPPLYING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnCount FROM procurement p
p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id
p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY CASE p.status WHEN 'ORDERED' THEN 0 WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, p.required_date, p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND p.selected_vendor_id = #{vendorId}

SELECT FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id
p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.inspection_result IS NOT NULL OR p.status IN ('SHIPPED','RECEIVED','RETURNED','RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING','CLOSED'))
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.received_at, p.shipped_at, p.updated_at) DESC

SELECT FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id
p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.inspection_result IN ('RETURNED','REJECTED','PARTIAL') OR p.status IN ('RETURNED','RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING'))
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id
p.selected_vendor_id IS NOT NULL AND p.status IN ('RECEIVED','STATEMENT_ISSUED','CLOSED')
ORDER BY p.received_at DESC, p.procurement_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vendor_quote q JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id = q.procurement_id SET q.unit_price = #{unitPrice}, q.delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, q.terms = #{terms}, q.submitted_at = NOW(), q.status = 'SUBMITTED' WHERE q.quote_id = #{quoteId} AND q.vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND q.status = 'REQUESTED' AND (p.quote_deadline IS NULL OR p.quote_deadline >= CURRENT_DATE)

UPDATE procurement SET terms = CONCAT(COALESCE(terms, ''), CASE WHEN COALESCE(terms, '') = '' THEN '' ELSE '\n' END, '[보완결과] ', #{supplement}), status = 'RESUPPLYING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE procurement_id = #{procurementId} AND selected_vendor_id = #{vendorId} AND status IN ('RETURNED', 'RETURN_REQUESTED')
